description: This file defines the 'SelectedFilterField' class, which represents an entity in the OrangeHRM system for managing selected filter fields in reports. It includes ORM mappings, properties, and accessor methods relevant to a filter field within a report.

classes.name: SelectedFilterField
classes.description: An ORM entity representing a selected filter field associated with a report, including properties for report reference, filter field reference, order, values, operator, and type.

methods.name: getFilterFieldOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the filter field.

methods.name: setFilterFieldOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of the filter field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of filter field.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of filter field.
